verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a native case management solution for prioritising and reviewing alerts. Cases carry an assignee and a case stage that can be filtered on, and analysts record case decisions in the web app or via the API. This confirms that assignment and staged review exist, but the evidence never documents how cases are assigned or moved between stages, or any escalation workflow. Missing for 10: documented case assignment and reassignment actions, configurable routing between review stages, an explicit escalation stage or four-eyes approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
